notes: This phase fixes political spatial semantics in the v2 display pipeline: an opposed polity is a counterparty, not the Person's own primary spatial placement.

Own-side/context relations currently eligible for primary spatial rendering are rules, governs, serves, active_in, and claims_rule; their original relation codes remain visible for later glyph styling.
If a Person has only opposes segments, v2 leaves primary placement unresolved instead of borrowing the opponent's coordinate.
Unknown or future relation codes are not guessed into either side and are routed to relation review.
No historical Activity is deleted or rewritten by this display partitioning layer, and Production v1 remains unchanged.
